chaining: the free package covers one translation model only: the product's API lists hunyuan-translation as its model. The other Tencent HY text models (Hy4 preview, Hy3, Hy-MT2-Pro, Hy-MT2-Plus, Hy-MT2-Lite) are sold on TokenHub, whose international edition grants each root account a one-time free trial of 1 million tokens for every language model, valid 1 year on the billing page (a promotion page states a shorter validity), and freezes 10 USD against the account balance or credit limit on each claim

free_tier.stated: A one-time free resource package of 1M tokens for Hunyuan-translation only, shared consumption, valid for 1 year from service activation and deducted before postpaid billing. After the package is used up or expires the service does not switch to postpaid on its own, and calls return a billing error until postpaid is enabled

limits.value: the package expires 1 year after service activation and unused tokens become invalid

binding_note: the quota covers a single translation model; any other model is billed

identity_cost.detail: account sign-up takes an email address (or a Google or WeChat login) with an emailed code, a mobile number of the registration location with an SMS code, and a payment card (the sign-up flow adds a 1.00 USD pre-authorization). The Tencent HY Global quick start puts real-name authentication before activating the Tencent HY console service; on the international site that is individual identity verification with a government ID card, passport, driver's license or work permit from the registration country, or enterprise verification with business registration documents. The account pages tie identity verification to mainland-China services, partner status and invoicing, so whether the Text Generation Global activation enforces it is unverified: behind a sign-up. The quick start page that states it is the 3D Global one; no text-generation quick start exists
